summary: RptMnuPlcSch_ConfirmLetters implements a report menu user control for generating Placement Schedule Confirmation Letters in HSPnet. It provides users with a workflow to select Departments, Programs, Terms, Cohorts/Courses, and report options, then initiates report creation through PrintJobs.ReportConfLetterCreateJob. Controls for including student names, HSPnet users, and options for PDF generation are wired with corresponding business rules and validations.
purpose: To allow authorized users to generate confirmation letter reports for placement schedules, selecting relevant departments, programs, terms, and options to customize the output, and to automate report creation with configurable recipient/CC options.

workflows.name: Generate Placement Schedule Confirmation Letter
steps: User loads the report menu user control on the page.
Departments, Programs, and Terms dropdowns are populated based on UserSession and AgencyID.
User selects Department, Program, and Term from dropdowns.
Cohorts/Courses list is populated according to selected Program and Term.
User selects recipients and CC options (Supervisor, Course Leader, Instructor, HSPnet users, Student names, Individual PDF).
Sender dropdown is initialized and selected.
System invokes PrintJobs.ReportConfLetterCreateJob with selected options and context.
Report job is processed and generated according to input parameters.

business_rules: UserSession.AgencyID limits Department and Program choices.
If no UserSession, report creation and data actions are blocked.
Maximum inclusion items for report is enforced (PrintJobs.MAX_INCLUDE_ITEMS).
CustomValidator2 displays error if maximum courses are exceeded.
validations: If UserSession is null, ObjectDataSourceSelecting event cancels data source operation.
CustomValidator2 ensures that the report job is not created if course inclusion exceeds maximum.
Dropdown fields require valid selection; blank entry allowed as first item.
calculations: Selection of Cohorts/Courses determined by TimetableCourseSearch and user role (CourseLeaderOnly).
conditions: UserSession must not be null to perform actions and load options.
If UserSession.AllowAllDepartments is true, Departments.DepartmentSearchAgency is used.
If UserSession.AllowAllPrograms is true, Programs.ProgramSearchDepartment is used.
system_behavior: Dropdowns auto-bind data on load, selection change, or explicit user action.
SetupJavaScript adds relevant variables to page scope for UI scripting.
Sender dropdown default is set to StaffID.
Report creation is a background job via PrintJobs.ReportConfLetterCreateJob.
exceptions: Report job is not created if more than MAX_INCLUDE_ITEMS courses are selected.
If UserSession is null, report cannot be generated and datasource operations are cancelled.
content_gaps: No explicit UI markup or description of user-facing layout.
No details on how generated reports are delivered or viewed.
No information about error handling beyond validation described.
